questions.question: Which Indian leader was affectionately called "Loknayak"?
questions.hint: Jayaprakash Narayan is popularly known as Loknayak (People's Leader).

questions.question: The concept of "Directive Principles of State Policy" was borrowed from which country?
questions.hint: DPSPs are borrowed from the Irish Constitution.

questions.question: Where is the Bandipur National Park located?
questions.hint: Bandipur National Park is established in Karnataka.

questions.question: Who was the first governor-general of independent India?
questions.hint: Lord Mountbatten served as the first Governor-General of independent India.

questions.question: Which river is known as the "Sorrow of Bengal"?
questions.hint: Damodar River was historically known as Sorrow of Bengal due to devastating floods.

questions.question: Which ancient Harappan site is famous for possessing a dockyard?
questions.hint: Lothal in Gujarat had a massive tidal dockyard connecting to the Sabarmati river.

questions.question: Who introduced the Permanent Settlement of land revenue in Bengal in 1793?
questions.hint: Lord Cornwallis introduced the zamindari permanent settlement system.

questions.question: Who appoints the Chief Election Commissioner of India?
questions.hint: The President of India appoints the CEC under Article 324.

questions.question: Which city was the capital of the ancient Satavahana dynasty?
questions.hint: Pratishthana (modern Paithan in Maharashtra) was the capital of the Satavahanas.

questions.question: Where is the Silent Valley National Park located in India?
questions.hint: Silent Valley National Park is located in the Nilgiri Hills, Palakkad district, Kerala.

questions.question: Where was the first session of the Indian National Congress held in 1885?
questions.hint: The first INC session was held at Gokuldas Tejpal Sanskrit College, Bombay.

questions.question: Which layer of the atmosphere contains the protective Ozone Layer?
questions.hint: The stratosphere contains the ozone layer (about 15-35 km above Earth).

questions.question: The separation of the judiciary from the executive is mentioned in which part of the Constitution?
questions.hint: Article 50 of the DPSPs directs the State to separate the judiciary from the executive.

questions.question: Who is the author of the famous ancient book "Panchatantra"?
questions.hint: Pandit Vishnu Sharma wrote the Panchatantra collection of animal fables in Sanskrit.

questions.question: Which act served as the primary blueprint for the Constitution of India?
questions.hint: More than half of the Constitution's provisions are adapted from the GOI Act of 1935.
